chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ubayd ibn Yahya al-Thawri al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-Alawi, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

When Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) with the manifestation of Islam and the Revelation appeared, he saw the scarcity of the Muslims and the abundance of the Polytheists. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was deeply grieved. So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent to him Jibreel (peace be upon him) with a lotus from the Lotus Tree (Sidrat al-Muntaha). So he washed his head with it, and his grief was removed by it.

key_terms.سِدْرُ الْمُنْتَهَى: The Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary

ai.seo_question: What happened to the Prophet's grief when Jibreel brought him a lotus from the Sidrat al-Muntaha?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the human dimension of the Prophet’s mission, illustrating how divine intervention via Jibreel and the Sidrat al-Muntaha provided spiritual relief during the vulnerable early Meccan period. It establishes a theological precedent for using specific blessed substances for purification, linking physical washing with the alleviation of spiritual anxiety (hamm).

en.hubeali:
From him, form Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ubeyd Bin yahya Al Sowr Al Attar, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn Al Alawy, from his father, from his grandfather, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Commanded Hisazwj Rasoolsaww with the manifestation of Al-Islam and the Revelation appeared, hesaww saw the scarcity of the Muslims and abundance of the Polytheists. So Rasool-Allahsaww was aggrieved by an intense grief. So Allahazwj Sent Jibraeelas to himsaww with a lotus from the Lotus Tree (Al-Sidrat Al-Muntaha). So hesaww washed hissaww head with it, and hissaww grief was removed by it’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Ubayd ibn Yahya al-Thawriy al-‘ Attar from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-‘Alawiy from his father from his grandfather who has said the following: “Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, commanded the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, to publicly announce his mission, he saw the small number of Muslims and the large number of the pagans. He (the Messenger of Allah) felt strongly depressed. Then Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, sent Jibril, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, with lotus tree leaves from the ultimate lotus tree. He washed with it his head and his depression went away.’”
